subset: Analysis uses only the messages in this loaded API page. Older/Newer replaces this subset; no full-window totals are calculated.
limits: Source deadline: 8 seconds; one response of at most 500 source rows; this page returns at most
unbounded: Loaded history subset without requested UTC date bounds.
noMore: No continuation was reported for this page. This does not establish continuous sensor coverage.
viewClock: The retrieval time is when this view received its last successful response; it is not a device receipt clock.
retained: The latest read failed; retained measurements keep their previous retrieval time.
unitGate: Values stay on the source scale. Source description labels do not independently establish calibration or a conversion rule.
counterGate: Counter scale, reset/rollover semantics and matching coverage are unproved. Physical counter deltas and source comparisons are unavailable.
rateGate: This source-labeled fuel rate is separate from fuel-used counters. Calibrated integration and matching distance coverage are unproved; no litres or L/100 km are calculated.
voltageGate: Battery Voltage (Starlink) does not establish voltage scale or external/internal supply identity. It is not a tracker vin/vbat reading or a battery-health diagnosis.
envelopeGate: Envelope spd/odo retain unconfirmed units. They do not inherit the units of CAN parameters or trip metrics.
calculationGate: Real source comparison, engine-counter deltas and fuel consumption are unavailable until scale, counter semantics and matching intervals are verified. Parameters 687 and 1657 remain separate. A counter decrease is not evidence of fuel theft or a device fault.
